meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能为项目接入 GitHub：复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、配置机器人账号的 token 与 webhook、设置访问策略，把仓库连到代理组。配置好后，有人在 PR/issue 评论里 @ 机器人，它会回复并跟进该线程。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 GitHub 频道、接入 PR/issue 评论，或配置 GitHub 评论机器人时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 GitHub 频道集成。
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并执行安装步骤。

say.text: 给 acme/backend 仓库接入 GitHub 评论机器人。
用 strict 策略把 GitHub 连到我的 agent 组。
say.note: 会添加成员并完成接线，且要求服务在运行。

howto.what_en: Agent gains GitHub channel via Chat SDK. It copies/registers adapter, installs dep, configures token/webhook/policy, wires repo to group. Bot answers @-mentions in PR/issue threads and keeps following them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a GitHub channel, enable PR/issue comment threads, or configure a GitHub comment bot for a repo.

say_en.text: Add GitHub channel integration for me.
say_en.note: Claude starts copying the adapter and setup steps.

say_en.text: Connect a GitHub comment bot for repo acme/backend.
say_en.note: Asks private/public then guides token and webhook setup.

say_en.text: Wire GitHub to my agent group with strict policy.
say_en.note: Adds members and completes wiring; service must run.
